Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

Do not invent separate owners for individual evidence categories.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "2028 Helio Start paid-acquisition proposal — readiness checklist", "body": "# 2028 Helio Start paid-acquisition proposal — readiness checklist

Use this gate before discussing a paid-acquisition proposal’s budget or channel tactics. Passing the evidence gate permits those discussions only; it does not approve a proposal, budget, paid traffic, launch, pipeline treatment or target, forecast credit, or an acquisition claim. Any eventual test still requires separate approval.

## Mature-evidence gate

- [ ] **Two consecutive mature cohorts:** Provide certified, complete day-90 outcomes for each of two consecutive cohorts. State each cohort’s exact admission dates, denominator, and outcome-window completeness; do not combine cohorts or omit a cohort’s limits.
- [ ] **Day-90 status:** Report the account-level paid-active status and mutually exclusive outcome counts for each cohort.
- [ ] **Refund-adjusted collected cash:** Report cash collected after refunds for each cohort, on a reconciled account-level basis. Keep gross billed cash distinct from collected cash.
- [ ] **Account-level support effort:** Report the distribution (including median and 90th percentile) and the count and share of accounts exceeding 90 support minutes for each cohort. Retain account-level support effort, including its denominator and measurement boundary.
- [ ] **Safety conditions in both cohorts:** Each cohort has fewer than 5% of accounts above 90 support minutes, and no unsupported case entered the admitted path.
- [ ] **Traceable, certified packet:** The reported figures reconcile to their source records and cohort denominators; immature or incomplete windows are not represented as mature results.

## How to combine the evidence

Present the measures together for **each cohort**: day-90 paid-active status, refund-adjusted collected cash, and account-level support effort. Keep their definitions, denominators, and cohort results visible; do not collapse them into a single conversion, revenue, or support score, average away a failing cohort, or substitute day-7 first integration for mature outcomes. Show the two consecutive cohorts side by side so the reader can assess both the commercial outcome and the support burden. Treat the evidence as descriptive unless a valid controlled design supports a causal claim; mature observational results alone do not establish causality, scalable acquisition economics, pipeline, or forecast.

## Package responsibility

**Owen and Customer Success jointly own the combined mature-evidence packet.** They certify the integrated cohort evidence as one package. Do not assign separate owners to individual evidence categories.

## Decision boundary

If any required cohort is incomplete, either cohort misses either safety condition, or the measures do not reconcile, the readiness gate is not met: do not proceed to budget or channel-tactics discussion.
